status: Exact additive interface; implementation and focused PG/HTTP qualification pending.

GET placements/{agent}.actor: Canonical administrator for same-authority agent, or that owner agent only. Nonadministrator services and other agents denied before subject lookup.
GET placements/{agent}.reply: hollywood-placement/v1 view below; current canonical state.

PUT placements/{agent}.actor: Canonical administrator only. Existing native source-v2/current participation for agent administrator; original administrative receipts. A paused agent cannot bypass its own enabled-placement native fence to resume itself.

body.hostId: required UUID matching SAME currently enrolled host; never transfer
body.enabled: required strict boolean: false pauses, true resumes

PUT placements/{agent}.reply: hollywood-placement/v1 view below. Each accepted new operation increments revision once, including same-state CAS; retry returns original receipt without another change. Changed wire under the same operation conflicts.

POST placements.compatibility: Unchanged original registration body and response. Existing enrolled rows keep enabled/generation/revision; legacy registration never resumes a paused placement. Existing rows migrate to revision1.

concurrency: GET uses existing shared authority fence; PUT uses exclusive authority fence, current administrator provenance and administrative actor/operation receipts. Append-only before/after state revisions supplement original receipts. Historical accepted results are not current inspection.
pauseEffect: Blocks new connector claim/admission and future native business mutations/preflight/begin that require currently enabled placement. Existing mechanisms recheck under the shared authority fence; no weakening of live source, active grant, cancellation or unknown fences.

Does not stop an executor/OS process, undo already-issued one-shot apply authority, cancel or replay requests, clear claims/permits/locks, transfer ownership, change generation/roles/private contexts, or drain work. Controller/bridge/executor drain remains independently required.
Resume only enables future explicitly checked operations. It admits/replays no request by itself; queued work and original receipts stay unchanged.

pausedResourceSetup.capabilityFlag: pausedResourceSetup=true on existing collaboration-bridge capability read.
pausedResourceSetup.agentGrant: Existing physical-workspaces/{workspace}/agent-grants/{agent} DTO unchanged. Active grants require active agent and registered matching placement, which may be paused. Actual registered() mutation check still requires enabled placement, active grant and exact source/root.
pausedResourceSetup.defaultSelection: Existing resource-default DTO unchanged. New selected pointer may be configured for active read/write local resource and registered paused placement. It is held while paused (participation-unavailable) with resource=null and mayApply=false.
pausedResourceSetup.resume: A NEW pointer revision selected during pause may become eligible on explicit resume if every root/grant/lifecycle pin still matches. A pointer that existed when pause occurred retains participation-invalidated and cannot silently revive; explicit reselection, including during pause, is needed.
pausedResourceSetup.metadata: Owner discovery remains filtered by enabled placement; administrators can inspect paused setup. Metadata creates no apply/admission authority.
pausedResourceSetup.resourceWireRevision: agent-resource-wire-r02.json supersedes r01 only for paused setup validation; original r01 remains immutable. canonical-delivery-edits/v1 request/schema/one-use semantics unchanged.

scope: Backend/SQL/API only. No LAX files, model/native/controller starts, runtime restart, production changes or duplicate integration request.
